Download saved backup

Download contains the last saved configuration and the backup's other keys, including credentials. Keep it in a private location. Unsaved text is not included.

Before opening the downloaded backup in the Ze CLI on Unix, restrict access to your account:

chmod 600 updated-backup.zefs

Workspaces expire after one hour without use and are removed when the daemon stops. Download your updated backup before closing.
